metric: Pairs shown different by a constraint-respecting database on which both queries were run (DuckDB), and pairs on which 150 random databases showed no difference (not a proof, not bounded verification).
correctness: Every refutation was executed on both queries and is stable under row-order shuffles; none are claimed without a database
caveats: No labels. 96 pairs are not run because DuckDB rejects Calcite-only syntax. One pair (a correlated EXISTS with an unqualified column) is read differently by DuckDB than by VeriEQL. 'unknown' here counts pairs that agree on every random database; 'unsupported' counts pairs DuckDB or the parser rejects.
